## Details

<a id="tune_ptrs"></a>
### [`tune_ptrs`](../../../../src/music/tunes.asm#L6) `$A171-$A254`

*data*

Start of each tune, 114 words (tunes $00-$71). The sound request $80+n in $dc-$de starts tune n.

- **Read by:** [`music_tick`](tick.md#music_tick)

<a id="tune_57"></a>
### [`tune_57`](../../../../src/music/tunes.asm#L37) `$A255-$A25D`

*data*

Tune data: bytes $00-$bf are notes, $c0-$cf select a note length, $f0-$f9 are commands with 0-2 argument bytes.

- **Entry of:** [`tune_ptrs`](../../tables.md#tune_ptrs)
